prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic high-contrast Film Noir portrait of an adult woman using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression exactly without celebrity or public-figure substitution. Give her a short shaggy jet-black bob haircut and dress her in a double-breasted black wool coat with a wide peak lapel. Place her in a dark narrow cobblestone alleyway at night, looking over her shoulder with an intense enigmatic expression. Let thick blue-tinted theatrical fog swirl around her, illuminated by a single dim overhead streetlamp. Use moody low-key clamshell lighting with a focused spotlight key, deep shadows, gritty alley texture, photorealistic 35mm film character, shallow depth of field, organic film grain, and moody color grading.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, smoking, cigarette, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed
